name: Tight Ellipse AABB Derivation
definition: Computes the tight axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) for a 2D ellipse defined by two basis vectors a and b.
summary: Tight Ellipse AABB Derivation computes the constant-time axis-aligned bounding box of a projected 2D Gaussian ellipse, replacing loose circular bounds to significantly reduce false-positive splat duplications during rasterization.
